name: macbook-scroll
blurb: 3D MacBook rotates into view on scroll, lid opening to reveal a display panel.
description: Renders a 3D MacBook with animated opening on scroll. The device scales, rotates, and opens via scroll progress, revealing a keyboard and trackpad below.
use_when: Product showcases or hero sections where scroll-triggered device opening creates dramatic visual impact.
avoid_when: Non-scroll contexts or mobile designs — scroll-driven animations and 3D perspective may not render as intended.
a11y: Scroll-driven animation with no keyboard interaction. Alt text for image content is used if provided; 3D effect itself is not announced.
